text:
The receptionist was not very friendly and did not smile, which made the overall atmosphere feel unwelcoming. This was quite disappointing.She really needs to improve her professionalism.

However, the dentist provided good service. The explanation during the scaling was clear and the communication was appropriate.

The queue management, however, was very poor. I had an appointment at 4:30 PM, but because I used social security, another walk-in customer who paid in cash was allowed to cut in line. As a result, I had to wait for more than 30 minutes. This was not acceptable and should be improved.

Best dentist that have ever met for my entire 40 years of life.
And reasonable price too!
Took away cavities start from 900B while other starts at 1.200B
I hadn’t been to dentist for 3 years, I had a lot and it cost me 1.000B

Most importantly the dentist was so patient and soft hand. I didn’t have a single drop of blood, like I usually has. She did such an amazing job.

I took my daughter to do check up and do some filling as well.

Even we live in Sweden and every kid get free dental care until age if 18.

I will still take her here next year.

Thank you very much for having me and my daughter (without advance booking)
See you next year! ;)

Very friendly service! The technician is very skillful and took great care of me. I had my teeth cleaned and it was the best experience I’ve ever had at the dentist. I called in and they were able to see me right away. Super easy appointment. In and out in under 30 minutes. My teeth feel sparkly clean. Affordable and reasonable prices.

Unless you get your appointment at 9am, it will be delayed. I came here just to cut off my stitches after wisdom tooth removal which could take only 2 minutes. I booked at 10:30, K.Orapan has no flexibility at all, must keep the order of patients only.  If i have the option I want to give 0.1 stars instead of 1

Good place for general dental work. I got  xrays, cleaning and some old amalgam fillings replaced with composite. Staff and service were great and the price was very reasonable. Can't ask for more than that.
Got dental implant recently. Professional service, the doctor is helpful and speaks good English. I'm very happy with his work. Recommended
Had my tooth extraction last week, Dentish did a very good job, far better than my experiences in Europe and good value for money. James H

Excellent service. Honest. A job well done. Very reasonable price. I recommend this practice; dentist Theerapol Kanta is an excellent and very professional dentist.

This is a dental clinic I personally really like.
The inlay on my tooth fell out, so I went to get it re-bonded. They temporarily bonded it for 1,000 baht. The doctor suggested completely removing any debris from the bonding surface and redoing it to make it work properly. However, since I'm a traveler, I asked for a temporary bonding. The doctor was incredibly helpful and painless.
This dental clinic is located 400-500 meters north of Pattaya Terminal 21, toward Naklua. I had made an appointment at another dental clinic, but I had to wait several days for an appointment. Because I couldn't eat, I went to many other dental clinics before finally finding this one.
I loved everything about this dental clinic.
1. The staff at the counter were very friendly.

They even spoke Korean.
2. The facilities were clean.
3. The prices were very reasonable.
* When I visited other dental clinics and asked questions, I found some that were charging outrageous prices.

Ich habe hier heute meine Zähne reinigen lassen. Eigentlich würden die Zähne nicht schlecht gereinigt, ich würde aber kein zweites Mal kommen. Im Grunde genommen war es eine Zahnsteinentfernung mit anschließender Politur, ohne Reinigung der Zahnzwischenräume und anschließend Fluorid. Als ich den Termin gemacht habe, wurde mir ein Preis von 900 Bat genannt, welcher auch in der Werbung stand. Bei der Behandlung hat sich der Preis fast verdoppelt, weil ich angeblich zu viel Zahnstein habe obwohl ich regelmäßig meine Zähne in Deutschland beim Zahnarzt reinigen lasse.
